title: 10-bit BT.2020 limited-range video converted with the 8-bit range offsets and matrix scale (16/255, 128/255, 255/219)
expected_finding: videoTex holds 10-bit samples normalized by 1023 (black at 64/1023, chroma midpoint 512/1023), but CSC_CONST_BUF is filled with the 8-bit limited-range constants: offsets 16/255 and 128/255 and a matrix scaled by 255/219 and 255/224 instead of 1023/876 and 1023/896, so black is lifted and neutral greys are tinted
